uncoveredRules.name: account-ownership
uncoveredRules.description:
Users can only read or modify their own accounts.
Admin users may access any account.

uncoveredRules.name: transfer-sufficient-funds
uncoveredRules.description:
The source account must have sufficient available balance to cover
the full transfer amount before the transfer is approved.

uncoveredRules.name: daily-transfer-limit
uncoveredRules.description:
The sum of all outgoing transfers from an account within a calendar day
must not exceed the account's configured daily_transfer limit.

uncoveredRules.name: card-activation-required
uncoveredRules.description:
A card must be in ACTIVE status before it can be used to process
purchases or ATM withdrawals.  Cards start in INACTIVE state.

uncoveredRules.name: account-closure-zero-balance
uncoveredRules.description:
An account can only be closed (deleted) when its current_balance is
exactly $0.00.  Any outstanding balance must be transferred or withdrawn
before closure is permitted.

uncoveredRules.name: duplicate-transaction-prevention
uncoveredRules.description:
If a transaction is submitted with an idempotency_key that was already
used for a previous successful transaction, the original transaction is
returned instead of creating a new one.

verification.condition: no existing transaction with same idempotency_key

uncoveredRules.name: minimum-transfer-amount
uncoveredRules.description:
The minimum allowed transfer amount is $1.00 USD (or equivalent in
the account's currency).  Transfers below this threshold are rejected.

uncoveredRules.name: suspended-account-no-transactions
uncoveredRules.description:
Accounts in SUSPENDED status must reject all incoming and outgoing
transactions and transfers.  The account holder should be directed
to contact support.

flow.name: Account Opening and First Transaction
flow.description:
A new user authenticates, opens a checking account, makes an initial
deposit via a credit transaction, then verifies their balance.

steps.name: authenticate
steps.description: User logs in and receives a JWT access token

steps.name: open-account
steps.description: User opens a new checking account with an initial deposit

steps.name: credit-transaction
steps.description: Record the initial deposit as a credit transaction

steps.name: verify-balance
steps.description: Confirm the account balance reflects the deposit
